<thought>The previous search with all criteria returned no templates. I will broaden the search by keeping the essential bond changes (forming C‑C and C‑O, breaking C‑O) and only requiring that a ketone is broken, which should match the intramolecular Michael addition template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C(Cc1ccc(O)cc1)C2CC(O)C3=CC=CC=C3O2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6", "6-8"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
